subject: Discovery follow-up: ACME - VPC/private deployment & SOC 2 questions
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jake Morrison <jm@acme.com>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: ACME - VPC/private deployment & SOC 2 questions

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Summary of what we discussed:
- Primary requirement: private VPC deployment with network isolation for production inference workloads.
- Must support customer-managed networking (VPC peering or PrivateLink) and option for on-prem/air-gapped packaging for regulated workloads.
- Compliance: ACME asked about current SOC 2 status, GDPR handling, and HIPAA posture for PHI use cases.
- Evidence: ACME will need SOC 2 report (or expected timeline), encryption/KMS details, audit log retention, and data residency options.

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) I will send our vendor security questionnaire link and a short checklist for required artefacts (SOC 2 report, encryption details).
2) Marcus to coordinate technical follow-up (network diagram, deployment options and on-prem packaging).
3) Neha to coordinate legal/compliance evidence and timelines for SOC 2 / HIPAA readiness.
4) Schedule a follow-up with ACME infra (30–45 min) next week to walk through the deployment diagram and connectivity options.

Attachments: redwood_vpc_architecture.pdf (high level diagram) — included for context.

Could you confirm preferred time windows for next week (I have availability Wed/Thu mornings PST) and whether Tom should join the infra call?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0189
[Attachment: redwood_vpc_architecture.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)]

From: Jake Morrison <jm@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 17:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: ACME - VPC/private deployment & SOC 2 questions

Appreciate the recap, Marissa — that matches what we covered. A few clarifications from our side:
- SOC 2: we need a copy of any most recent SOC 2 report or an expected audit completion date. If Redwood is in process, we can accept a slide deck/summary + expected timeline.
- HIPAA/GDPR: primary ask is that logs and query data relevant to PHI are never exported to shared systems; we also need to understand retention controls.
- On-prem/air-gap: we are exploring an air-gapped option for one of our regulated customers; can you confirm whether Redwood offers an on-prem appliance or an install bundle?

Tom — please coordinate availability for the infra call; mornings PST work for us as well.

Thanks,
Jake Morrison
Director, Platform Security — ACME Corp
jm@acme.com
+1 (617) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Discovery follow-up: ACME - VPC/private deployment & SOC 2 questions

Forwarding ACME thread — they asked for SOC 2 evidence and confirmation of our on-prem/air-gapped offering. Key asks:
- Send vendor security questionnaire link to ACME (see related link) and ask for point of contact for evidence upload.
- Marcus: can you prepare two short artifacts for the infra call: 1) production VPC deployment diagram showing peering/private connectivity and egress controls; 2) a note on our on-prem install bundle / air-gapped options and what is included (packages, expected install windows, support model).
- Neha: please draft an evidence checklist (SOC 2 report or summary, KMS details, audit log retention policy, DPA/GDPR notes) that we can send with the questionnaire.

I attached the high-level architecture we shared earlier. I’m tentatively proposing Thu 08/16 at 09:30am PT for a 30-min infra walkthrough — Marcus, does that work?

Thanks — I’ll send the questionnaire link to Jake once we have the checklist in place.

Marissa
[Attachment: redwood_vpc_architecture.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Jake Morrison <jm@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Aug 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: ACME - VPC/private deployment & SOC 2 questions

Hi Jake — thanks for the quick reply and the clarifications. A few concrete items from our side: 

1) SOC 2 evidence: we have a redactable SOC 2 Type II report from 2027 and a compliance summary pack — attaching the summary. If you need the full report we'll share via a secure upload.
2) Vendor security questionnaire: please use the link below to access our questionnaire (it includes a checklist for SOC 2, KMS, logging, data retention, and data residency). Once you submit, Neha will review and request any missing artefacts.
   Questionnaire link: https://redwood.app/sq/ACME-12345

3) On-prem / air-gapped: Redwood offers an install bundle for air-gapped environments. The bundle includes the inference runtime, a configuration guide, and a support engagement for installation. It does not include hardware; we provide an installation playbook and can send an installer package under an NDA. For the infra call I can walk through the install flow and network requirements (outbound-only, local registry option, KMS integration patterns).

4) Network diagram: attached a short diagram showing VPC peering + private connectivity and recommended egress controls.

Proposed next step: 30-min infra walkthrough Thu 08/16 09:30am PT — confirm and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
[Attachment: soc2-snapshot-2027.pdf (PDF, redactable)]
